links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated TKA patient education responses across six indices
links.effect: All responses fell within a secondary-school readability range; Gemini Advanced produced slightly less complex text on several indices, other measures comparable.
links.quote: All responses fell within a secondary-school readability range.

screen.reason: Evaluated the accuracy, applicability, and readability of two LLMs answering frequently asked patient questions about total knee arthroplasty with surgeon raters; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
